item.title: The gigawatt land grab: why Meta went to Alberta, and what it costs
item.description: Meta just broke ground on a CAD $13B, 1-gigawatt AI data centre in rural Alberta — its first in Canada and 33rd worldwide. Strip away the ribbon-cutting and it is a case study in the real bottleneck of the AI boom: not chips, not talent, but power, land, and the political will to permit both. Here is our read on who wins.

item.title: The measuring stick: why the dollar, not the Strait of Hormuz, may be pulling oil down
item.description: Oil has round-tripped its entire war spike even though Hormuz transit is still choked — and gold, silver, Bitcoin, and megacap stocks fell right alongside it. One underappreciated variable ties them together: a strengthening US dollar. Here is the case for watching the measuring stick, not the barrel.

item.title: The token paradox: AI's economy is exploding, deflating, and barely profitable
item.description: Token volumes are up hundreds of times over, the price of intelligence is collapsing ~10x a year, growth is already decelerating — and almost no one selling tokens is making money. Here is who actually wins.
